geminias:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production Unity game animation SPRITE SHEET, transparent PNG. Create ONE image, exactly 2048 pixels wide and 3072 high, an exact uniform grid of 8 columns and 12 rows (96 frames), each square cell 256x256. NO text, grid lines, numbers, labels or backgrounds. Every cell has transparent background. Each character centered at x128 in its cell with feet baseline y230, full body within cell, consistent scale ~190px tall, 20px safe gutter. Camera fixed front three-quarter, no changes in zoom. Reference image is ONLY a style reference for polished cute chunky 3D rendered robot game sprites, not a character to reproduce.
Character: GEMINIAS THE TWOFOLD ORACLE, original personification of a cosmic dual intelligence. A small formidable chibi astral automaton, TWO distinct porcelain robotic face masks side by side on ONE torso, both clearly visible; one cyan-eyed, one violet-eyed. Ivory and midnight-blue metallic armor, floating asymmetric star crown, dark blue split coat, blue/violet four-point star in chest, compact mechanical boots, two expressive hands. No text or company logos. Distinct confident twin personality, celestial magical energy. Clean beautiful collectible videogame boss quality matching existing reference's 3D finish and readable chunky silhouette.
Read rows top to bottom, frames left to right. ALL EIGHT frames per row must show distinct progressive ANIMATION poses, never unrelated designs:
row1 normal idle loop, breathing hover crown and alternating twin blinks.
row2 normal hurt, recoil from impact then recovery.
row3 transformation, cyan energy gradually shifts armor to midnight violet and crown expands, ends ascended.
row4 ascended idle loop, violet/gold accents and intense star eyes, same character.
row5 ascended hurt then recovery.
row6 normal attack anticipation, hands progressively gather compact cyan star orb on right, hold charged final frames.
row7 normal attack discharge, launch star orb from right hand, arms extend then recover. Entire effect inside cell.
row8 normal blocked attack, star cracks, surprised faces and recoil then recover.
row9 ascended anticipation, violet dual star orb charge.
row10 ascended attack discharge, twin violet star launch then recover.
row11 ascended blocked, violet stars break and recoil then recover.
row12 defeat, stagger, kneel, armor dims, dissolves progressively into a few tiny stars in last frame.
Preserve exact anatomy, equipment, TWO faces and fixed grid registration in all 96 frames. Genuine transparent alpha between sprites and around every sprite. No floor shadows, no contact sheets of varying frame sizes.
claudio:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production Unity game animation SPRITE SHEET with transparent background. ONE image exactly 2048 wide x3072 high, uniform grid EIGHT columns and TWELVE rows, 96 square 256x256 cells. NO text, NO grid, NO labels. Transparent alpha around sprites. Fixed orthographic front-three-quarter camera. Each full-body character centered in its cell, 190px tall, same scale and baseline at y230 of cell, safe gutters. Reference image used ONLY for polished chunky chibi 3D robot sprite rendering and sprite layout.
Character CLAUDIO THE SCRIBE OF VERDICTS, original AI-inspired fictional boss. Compact imposing chibi mechanical monk-judge with dignified ivory porcelain face mask, narrow warm amber eyes and subtly skeptical eyebrows; copper sunburst ornament behind head, burgundy hood and flowing short burgundy mantle over dark bronze robotic armor, cream manuscript-like stole with abstract nonletter etched markings. A floating OPEN cream-paged book by left hand and elegant copper feather quill by right hand. Stocky mechanical boots, one body ONE face. Recognizable expressive appealing fantasy-sci-fi robot boss, beautiful detailed 3D metallic materials and cinematic rim lighting, easy to read at 256px. NO writing, NO company logos, NO hats. Warm copper orange and parchment normal form, bright molten gold and deep wine ascended form.
All eight cells of each row show DIFFERENT incremental frames of the SAME motion, anatomy and costume. Row ordering top to bottom, frames left to right:
row1 normal idle loop, breathe, blink, book gently floating, feather tips move.
row2 normal hurt, surprise recoil, book tilts, recover.
row3 transformation normal to ascended, copper sunburst unfolds and becomes golden, cloak glows amber, pages flutter.
row4 ascended idle loop, gold eyes, glowing sunburst, book hovering.
row5 ascended hurt recoil and recover.
row6 normal attack preparation, lift quill, book opens, glowing copper circular seal grows in front of right hand; final poses hold charge.
row7 normal attack, quill makes forceful flourish, fire copper verdict seal to right, then recover. Effects fully inside each cell.
row8 normal blocked, seal cracks, startled skeptical mask, recoils and recovers.
row9 ascended preparation, gold quill and molten gold seal gathering.
row10 ascended attack, golden verdict seal launched, book pages swirling, recovery.
row11 ascended blocked, golden seal shatters, recoil and recover.
row12 defeat, stagger, book closes and falls, kneel, porcelain cracks, light dims, progressively dissolves to warm gold motes by last frame.
No background, no environment, no floor, no shadows outside character. True alpha transparency, no painted checkerboard. Keep every sprite inside its own 256x256 cell. Frame continuity is critical.
